name: barha-maison
description: BARHA — Haute Parfumerie. A full-stack React + Node demo experience.

scripts.dev: concurrently -n SERVER,CLIENT -c magenta,cyan "npm --prefix server run dev" "npm --prefix client run dev"
scripts.build: npm --prefix client install && npm --prefix client run build
scripts.vercel-build: node scripts/validate-config.mjs && node scripts/check-image-refs.mjs && npm --prefix client install && npm --prefix client run build
scripts.heroku-postbuild: npm --prefix client install && npm --prefix client run build
